capabilities.cloudflare: Managed DDoS, CDN cache, Tiered Cache/Cache Reserve as plan-appropriate
capabilities.fastly: Network DDoS service, CDN cache, shielding
capabilities.aws: CloudFront plus Shield Standard/Advanced and Origin Shield
capabilities.azure: Front Door global edge, DDoS platform controls, caching
capabilities.required_rollout: Provider/account activation and cache validation are manual; do not claim completion from policy code.

capabilities.aws: AWS WAF managed rule groups on a Web ACL
capabilities.azure: Front Door Premium managed WAF rule sets
capabilities.required_rollout: Observe/count or narrow challenge before block; document managed-rule exclusions.

capabilities.cloudflare: Zone custom rulesets, IP Lists, threat/bot fields
capabilities.aws: AWS WAF statements, IP sets, labels, geo and rate statements
capabilities.azure: Custom WAF rules, geo match, managed bot/reputation capabilities
capabilities.required_rollout: Geo off by default; reputation cannot be a permanent deny without confirmed abuse.

capabilities.cloudflare: Verified bots, Bot Management score, Managed Challenge
capabilities.fastly: Bot Management/Next-Gen WAF signals and response controls
capabilities.aws: Bot Control labels, CAPTCHA/Challenge where compatible
capabilities.azure: Bot Manager managed rule set and WAF actions
capabilities.required_rollout: Preserve verified crawlers and non-browser API/webhook clients; avoid zone-wide blanket challenges.

capabilities.aws: AWS WAF rate-based rules, scoped by labels/statements
capabilities.azure: Front Door WAF rate-limit custom rules
capabilities.required_rollout: Independent route/action/characteristic mapping; webhook actions must be non-interactive.

capabilities.cloudflare: Transform Rules, Cache Rules, Origin Rules
capabilities.fastly: VCL/Compute response transforms and cache configuration
capabilities.aws: CloudFront response-headers, cache, origin-request policies and Functions/Lambda@Edge where required
capabilities.azure: Front Door Rules Engine and route/cache settings
capabilities.required_rollout: CSP Report-Only first; sensitive response cache bypass remains mandatory.

capabilities.cloudflare: Authenticated Origin Pulls/mTLS, Tunnel, egress ACL or overwritten secret header
capabilities.fastly: TLS client identity, private connectivity/ACL or signed secret to origin
capabilities.aws: S3 Origin Access Control, private ALB/API patterns, secret header plus WAF where appropriate
capabilities.azure: Front Door Premium Private Link, origin validation and access restrictions
capabilities.required_rollout: Origin must reject direct ingress. GitHub Pages cannot satisfy this and remains an explicit exception.

capabilities.cloudflare: Security Analytics/Events, Logpush, account audit logs
capabilities.fastly: Real-time log streaming, observability integrations, audit logs
capabilities.aws: WAF/CloudFront logs, CloudWatch metrics/alarms, CloudTrail/config controls
capabilities.azure: Diagnostic logs, Log Analytics, Monitor alerts and activity logs
capabilities.required_rollout: Suppress secrets/bodies, minimize IP retention, and retain policy version/operator/timestamp.
